Talent0_2Ability.name: Coexistence Theory
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: Auto deploy <buf ID=1099900>[Goo Goo]</buf> after sortie. <buf ID=1099900>[Goo Goo]</buf> can protect allies within <color=#F74848>1</color> adjacent tile from melee, assault and ranged attack. <buf ID=1099900>[Goo Goo]</buf> inherits <color=#F74848>75%</color> max HP and <color=#F74848>100%</color> of other attributes from [Sapientia].

Talent3_5Ability.name: Coexistence Theory
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
Auto deploy <buf ID=1099900>[Goo Goo]</buf> after sortie. <buf ID=1099900>[Goo Goo]</buf> can protect allies within <color=#F74848>1</color> adjacent tile from melee, assault and ranged attack. <buf ID=1099900>[Goo Goo]</buf> inherits <color=#F74848>75%</color> max HP and <color=#F74848>100%</color> of other attributes from [Sapientia].
<buf ID=1099900>[Goo Goo]</buf>'s defense is increased by <color=#F74848>35%</color>, DMG taken is reduced by <color=#F74848>10%</color>, and she gains <color=#F74848>1</color> additional AP upon deployment.

500001.name: CEC 1
500001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

700015.name: Rotation
700015.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if no damage was dealt this turn, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

500803.name: Damage Control
500803.SpecificEffects: While being within <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles around <buf ID=1099900>[Goo Goo]</buf>, DMG taken is reduced by <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

500804.name: Synchronization Repair
500804.describe: Restores HP of all allies within <range type=2>2-tile</range> diamond around <buf ID=1099900>[Goo Goo]</buf> and this unit for <color=#F74848>0.85</color> Manipulator Repair AMT. Can restore <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part.

500805.name: Safety Protocol
500805.SpecificEffects: After active repairs, grants <buf ID=1099905>[Command Block Immunity]</buf> to the targets, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

500806.name: Double Preparation
500806.describe: Selects <color=#F74848>2</color> allies within <color=#F74848>4</color> adjacent tiles, restores <color=#F74848>1.75</color> Manipulator Repair AMT to all parts. Can restore <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part.

500807.name: Integrity Validation
500807.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1099900>[Goo Goo]</buf> restores <color=#F74848>35%</color> HP to the lowest HP part at the end of turn.

500808.name: Optimal Reconstruction
500808.describe: Restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>2.6</color> Manipulator Repair AMT to all parts of a target and restores all destroyed parts. Also refreshes the turn count of all buffs and reduces CD of <color=#F74848>1</color> active command skill by <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

500809.name: Regulated Repair
500809.describe: Restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>2.0</color>x Manipulator Repair AMT to all parts of a single ST. Can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part. If the target is <buf ID=1099900>[Goo Goo]</buf>, grants <buf ID=7100901>[Movement Up]</buf> for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

summonSkills.name: Super Goo Goo!
summonSkills.SpecificEffects: Can use <buf ID=1099901>[Support Defend]</buf> to protect allies within <color=#F74848>1</color> adjacent tile from melee, assault and ranged attack. This effect can trigger up to <color=#F74848>3</color> times per turn. Gains <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after triggering.

summonSkills.name: Goo Goo Cover!
summonSkills.describe: Protect allies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles from melee, assault and ranged attack. This effect can trigger up to <color=#F74848>3</color> times per turn, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. Also grants <buf ID=1099902>[Short Circuit Impact!]</buf> for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns, and allows the unit to move <color=#F74848>2</color> additional tiles.

summonSkills.name: Goo Goo Boost!
summonSkills.describe: Restores <color=#F74848>2</color> AP to an ally within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles.

summonSkills.name: Goo Goo Shift!
summonSkills.describe: Swap position with an ally within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles. Can continue to move with remaining movement.

500011.name: CEC 2
500011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

500012.name: Part Maintenance 1
500012.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, dispel <color=#F74848>1</color> debuff.

500021.name: CEC 3
500021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

500031.name: Emergency Repair 1
500031.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, randomly select a single adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) ally to perform <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> the Manipulator's Manipulator Repair AMT and cannot repair damaged parts.

500033.name: Flexible Repair
500033.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, an additional <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

500034.name: Emergency Repair 2
500034.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf> selects targets within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area.

500035.name: Emergency Repair 3
500035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>'s Manipulator Repair AMT is now <color=#F74848>1x</color> that of the Manipulator.

500036.name: Emergency Repair 4
500036.SpecificEffects: The number of targets that <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf> can repair increases by <color=#F74848>1</color>.

500841.name: Machine Intelligence 1
500841.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1099900>[Goo Goo]</buf> repair skills can ignore distance.

500043.name: Part Maintenance 3
500043.SpecificEffects: Each turn, the AP Cost of the 1st repair skill decreases by <color=#F74848>1</color>, with a minimum cost of <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

500845.name: Machine Intelligence 3
500845.SpecificEffects: While <buf ID=1099900>[Goo Goo]</buf> is present, [Sapientia]'s Repair AMT is increased by <color=#F74848>15%</color>, and she is immune to <buf ID=1099903>[Command Block]</buf> effect.

500846.name: Machine Intelligence 4
500846.SpecificEffects: Allies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles around <buf ID=1099900>[Goo Goo]</buf> can be targeted with Repair skills.
